Description:
A storm gathers strength on the horizon - a sign of the wrathful spirits that stir with agitation. The seer gazes upon you, eyes as white and cold as frost, peering beyond the mundane realm into the shadowed depths of your soul. "You are not prepared," he intones. Another member of the tribe emerges, draped in a hide of a wolf, arms brown and blue inscribed with unknown marks and a hefty axe resting upon his back. "The ritual must continue" he declares. "We are but frail beings, in these mortal vessels, and the spirit realm draws close. Alone, we stand defenseless."
Shamans are spirit guides and warriors of the other realm who often engage in ancient rituals and soul magic beyond most mortals' comprehension. Through body, mind or soul, each shaman finds their way to commune with or destroy the spirits haunting or aiding the lands.
A shaman is a fierce warrior and a powerful spellcaster who taps into their ancestry to empower magic, survive inhumane conditions, or even engage in occult practices to better flow with the world around them.
Quick Note: A shaman is a fierce warrior and a powerful spellcaster who taps into their ancestry to empower magic, survive inhumane conditions, or even engage in occult practices to better flow with the world around them.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. One-Handed Melee, Two-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Shaman-specific Abilities are considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Recommended Abilities Description:
Chilling Shout is a great way to spend Mana to deal damage. Invigorate will keep your party alive - make sure you keep them at full health! Panic Lash will come in handy against enemies that Heal, or in case you ever need just a 1 Action Point. Confusion is a very good source of distruption, and Restoration will bring your party back from being Fallen with no repercussions.
The last suggestion is Mastery. This one is very situational, as it allows you to use your Presence or Charism to attack with weapons instead of Might or Instinct. If you already have high Might and Instinct, consider getting something else instead. A good recommendation is Speak With Animals for some extra utility for your group.

Other:
As a Shaman, you have a spirit animal that represents you.
Choose one of the following spirit animals.
You will permanently gain the bonuses of that spirit animal.

Starting Abilities Description.Animal Spirit:
As a Shaman, you have a spirit animal that you choose when you create your Hero.
This spirit animal accompanies you spiritually.
The spirit animal is generally invisible and manifests as a ghostly presence when you use the Ability specific to it.

~Better Echo~.Effect: The first spell you cast each combat repeats next round at half effect.

~Farsight or Foresight~.Effect: You can see the future, like what a Unit will do and its result. Roll anticipatory dice for it or something.

~Where Did Witchdoctor Go?~.Effect: Hold a concoction a number of turns - the longer you hold it, the more damage/stun. It may explode on you though (if you roll 1 but the dice increases)

~Revenant~.Effect: When you die, you rise as a revenant

~Echoes~.Effect:
After you cast a Basic Ability, roll 1d8.
If you rolled 8 on it, the Ability _echoes_ and you cast it again (for 0 {A}Action Points), but ^all^ Damage or Healing it does is reduced by 50%.
The _echoed_ Ability can't affect the same target(s) or area.
~Echoes~.Notes:
Abilities like Recuperate can't _echo_, since the only possible target is yourself.
If the area overlaps the initial area, the overlapped part has no effect. If it hits the same target(s), it has no effect on them.
Take the Ability text as it is - _echoing_ Lightning Storm repeats the initial Damage, but you'd have to spend another 2 {A}Action Points to retrigger the second Lightning Storm.
The QM has the word on whether something is possible.

~Link Minds~.Effect:
Establish a mind connection with a willing ally.
For the rest of the Adventure, you can talk to eachother telepathically.
~Link Minds~.Notes: You can only have one Focus Linked ally at a time.

~Guidance~.Effect: When an ally makes a Check, it can use your modifiers (including being Skilled in that Skill) instead of its own.

~Dispel Magic~.Effect: Dispell all ongoing _non-chronic_ magical effects on a Unit (any magical Control Effects, magical buffs and debuffs, etc).
~Dispel Magic~.Notes: Chronic effects are ones that last days, months or are permanent, such as curses, vampirism, etc.

~Disenchantment~.Duration: 8 hours (24 hours at level 4, 1 week at level 8)
~Disenchantment~.Effect:
A person makes a Presence Check.
If it fails, it becomes afflicted with a minor (usually non-combat) curse, such as:
{Diamond} Its Setback is doubled
{Diamond} The target can't properly tie knots, sew, use keys or pick locks, etc
{Diamond} The target appears less attractive (its Presence Checks have -3)
{Diamond} Gains runny nose, eyes and sweats more
{Diamond} Stumbles randomly
~Disenchantment~.Notes: A Unit can't be affected by the same Disenchantment effect multiple times.

~Fairy Fire~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4x4 meter area.
All Units in that area become outlined in a colored glow (you choose the color). They can't benefit from Cover, turn invisible and their Surprise bonus/minus is cancelled.
~Fairy Fire~.Notes:
The Units glow even through walls, but the denser the walls, the less they appear to glow.
A 1-meter (thickness) of concrete wall completely blocks the glow.
This is not considered a Control Effect.

~Blood and Salt~.Effect: Until the start of your next turn, you take -1d4 Damage from all sources.

<Incorporeal Form>.Effect:
You become a bodyless soul for up to 8 hours and enter a willing ally.
While inside the ally's body, you can communicate with them mentally, and only they can see you.
You can slightly peek outside of their body, and move your arms, upper body and head as if you were a ghost originating from that ally's body.
{Diamond} You can't move yourself, but you always move with that ally.
{Diamond} You can't do any physical actions (because you are a ghost and can't touch anything or anyone).
{Diamond} You can cast spells normally. 
{Diamond} You follow your own Initiative in combat.
{Diamond} You can't take Control Effects from external sources, but you feel every body sensation that ally feels.
You can freely exit their body and revert back to your physical self using 0 {A}Action Points.

<Dream Walk>.Effect:
Make a Presence Check against another non-Epic Unit's Presence Check. If you succeed, it falls Asleep for 2 turns.
Alternatively, you can use Dream Walk on an already sleeping target to alter their dreams to your liking.
<Dream Walk>.Notes: A Sleeping Unit wakes up if it takes Damage or other Control Effects.

<Enlightening Ritual>.Effect:
You undergo an isolated, personal and mind-altering ritual with a willing non-Warlock Hero at a campfire, and using incense, smoke and special herbs.
The ally must make a Presence Check against 6 + Your Presence.
If it succeeds, its Max {Mana}Mana permanently increases by 1, and gets +2 to all Checks for the rest of the Adventure.
If it fails, it takes 1d8 Psychic Damage and gets -1 to all Checks for the rest of the Adventure.
<Enlightening Ritual>.Upgrade:
You can perform this ritual as many times as you want per Adventure until you succeed once. It costs you 1 {Mana}Mana (not Max {Mana}Mana), which is spent when the ally passes the ritual.
A person can only succeed one Enlightening Ritual in their lifetime.
Respeccing keeps the effects for your Ally.

<Rainmaking>.Effect:
Perform a ritual to change the weather or atmosphere on a 100 meter area (in diameter) centered on you.
Choose one option from Storm, Wind, Heat, Cold.
<Rainmaking>.Notes: In dungeons and indoors, this only goes through open doors and spaces - the weather starts from you and extends as much as possible through open holes, windows, doors, etc.

Values: Your team deals 2 extra Damage with all Spells
Your team has +1 Movement Speed, +1 Damage with missiles and can freely jump 5 meters (using Movement)
Your team deals 2 extra Damage with physical weapons

<Psyche Tether>.Effect:
Place a tether on 2 Units within 10 meters of you.
The next time one of them is Damaged or Healed, the other one takes the Damage (as Psychic Damage) or Healing as well.
<Psyche Tether>.Notes:
If both are Damaged/Healed at the same time, this only applies once and you choose which takes the Damage/Healing of the other.
The extra Damage of Smites, Ambush, etc over an attack counts as the same Damage source.

~Sending~.Effect: Send a message no longer than 5 seconds long to an ally, wherever it is. It can include images, sounds and smells. That ally knows they received a message from you.
~Sending~.Upgrade: Requires you to be holding something physical from that ally, such as a piece of clothing, an object, a strand of hair, etc.
~Sending~.Notes: Sending might be impeded if sent to another plane/world.

~Telekinesis~.Effect:
For the next 1 minute, while channeling, you can manipulate objects 10 meters away from you as if used by your own hand.
You can also zoom in on your vision, hearing and smelling up to 10 meters away.

<Forced Echoes>.Effect: Your Shaman Abilities and Talents always _echo_.
<Forced Echoes>.Notes: Rainmaking applies 2 effects when echoed. Enlightening Ritual can now, instead, succeed twice per Adventure (Units still can't succeed it more than once).

<Synchronicity>.Effect: Your _echo_ dice become 2d8 (instead of 1d8). Each rolled 8 makes the Ability Echo.

<Reincarnation>.Effect:
Use when you or an ally you can see Falls or dies. Choose an animal from the Pets and Animals list.
They immediately come to life as a translucent spirit version of that Animal.
Lasts until the ally Rises (or the animal dies too).
<Reincarnation>.Upgrade: The ally can do Animal Attack (Druid), which does 1d6 + ^their Presence^ Damage (for a 1 {A}Action Point).
